summary: Iteration 49 — MO-028 all-6-departments + cycle_log improvement AND Phase B Factory Concierge™ full-stack validation. Backend pytest: 11/11 PASSED in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration49_concierge_and_mo028.py in 1.82s (parallel xdist workers). MO-028 improvement: (a) POST /api/media-library/improvement-loop with weak scenes + topic='forex' + threshold=95 returns civilization_status[] with ALL 6 departments (creative_director, design_intelligence, director_intelligence, learning_experience, knowledge_verification, qa); idle departments correctly report standby=true, progress=100, blocked=false and activity mentions 'Standing by — no work required this run'. (b) Response now includes cycle_log[] with populated entries {cycle:int>=1, department, dimension, from, to, delta==to-from, line contains department name} recording exactly which department raised which score each pass. (c) Passing case (topic='forex' at threshold=85 with strong scenes) → every non-blocking non-standby department reports progress=100 (honesty invariant). (d) Sensitive-topic regression (topic='obscure medical xyz zzz', narration mentions 'medical health claims', threshold=95) → gold_master_candidate_ready=false, blocking_count>=1, knowledge_verification row has blocked=true; all 6 depts still present. Factory Concierge Phase B: (a) 'Create a video about forex trading for beginners' (no session_id) → stage='ready', slots.outcome_id='video', slots.topic contains 'forex' AND 'trading', slots.audience='Beginner adult', can_launch=true, plan.knowledge_gap.knowledge_record_found=true, launch.workflow non-empty, session_id issued. (b) 'I want to make a workbook' → stage='need_topic', outcome captured, topic empty, plan=null, can_launch=false. (c) Same session_id follow-up 'about medieval basket weaving' → session persists, slots accumulate (outcome_id='workbook' retained + topic captured), stage='knowledge_gap', can_launch=false, plan.knowledge_gap.knowledge_record_found=false, reply honestly mentions 'Knowledge Record' / 'Knowledge Manufacturing Pipeline' (never fabricates a KR). (d) 'hello' or '' → stage='need_outcome' with suggestions[] chips (label, value, outcome_id) — 11 outcome chips returned. (e) POST without Authorization returns 401/403. (f) GET /api/factory-os/concierge/session/{sid} returns accumulated messages[] and slots for a session created via message endpoint; unknown sid returns 404. FRONTEND Playwright at /concierge (Founder login): greeting bubble appears EXACTLY ONCE (verified — greeted useRef pattern works, StrictMode double-mount prevented). Typing 'Create a video about forex trading for beginners' into concierge-input and clicking concierge-send produces 3 total bubbles (greeting + user + concierge). Right-rail Your request panel fills: Creating=Video, About=Forex Trading, For=Beginner adult, with 'Gold Master Ready' status chip and 'via MO-012 Controlled Flagship Showcase™'. Knowledge-First panel shows concierge-kr-found (approved KR row) + concierge-launch button labelled 'Launch MO-012 Controlled Flagship Showcase™' (enabled, NOT clicked to avoid project side-effects). Knowledge-gap branch (message 'make a poster about medieval basket weaving'): concierge-kr-gap panel shown, concierge-begin-knowledge button labelled 'Begin the Knowledge Manufacturing Pipeline' visible, concierge-launch and concierge-kr-found ABSENT — honesty preserved. concierge-reset (Start over) clears kr-found/kr-gap/launch panels, brings back 11 outcome suggestion chips + stage returns to need_outcome. Clicking concierge-suggestion-video advances the flow (outcome=Video shown in Your request panel). ai-toggle present and defaults OFF (deterministic $0 flow). No console errors observed. Design: dark-blue conversation card, gold KR-gap button, royal accent — no contrast issues.
action_items: OPTIONAL / MINOR UX — factory_concierge.py::handle_message: after the reset regex clears slots, the same message 'start over' is still run through _deterministic_parse; _extract_topic returns 'Start Over' as a topic, which then repopulates slots['topic']. Visible symptom: after clicking concierge-reset the right-rail 'About' can momentarily show 'Start Over' until the next real turn (and if the user clicks an outcome chip immediately, they can be pushed straight into a knowledge_gap on topic 'Start Over'). Suggested fix: when the reset regex matches, skip parsing and just render the greeting (i.e. return early after resetting slots). Not blocking — the test suite still shows correct stage/suggestions and the user can retype their real request.

OPTIONAL — reset() in FactoryConcierge.js calls send('start over', null) which displays a user 'start over' bubble before the greeting. If the intent is 'returns to the greeting' cleanly, consider sending an empty greeting-only turn (send('', null)) so the message list contains only the concierge greeting, matching Login screenshots more closely.
critical_code_review_comments: improvement_loop.py::run_loop (lines 163-188) — the 'always render all 6 departments' block is elegant: iterates DEPARTMENTS in insertion order, appends QA row explicitly, uses `active` dict for departments with work orders, and appends a Standby row for the rest with progress=100/blocked=false/standby=true and a clear 'Standing by — no work required this run' activity. Correct honesty signal: idle ≠ blocked, and Founder sees the full workforce at a glance.

improvement_loop.py::run_loop (lines 130-135) — cycle_log entries are recorded ONLY when a work order actually moved a dimension (skipped for blocking + Complete + at-ceiling). Every entry captures {cycle, department, dimension, from, to, delta, line} — audit-grade. Consider also emitting a 'no-op' entry on cycles where every WO is at ceiling so the audit trail is never silent on why the loop exited early; today this is inferred from cycles[].composite being flat.

factory_concierge.py — deterministic-first, Knowledge-First guarantee is correct: _ai_parse is optional and never called unless use_ai=true, and even then it can only touch outcome_id/topic/audience/goal — NEVER the KR check. The KR check is always delegated to fos.knowledge_gap_check (deterministic MongoDB lookup on verified KRs). Zero hallucination risk verified end-to-end.

factory_concierge.py::_extract_topic — the regex '\b(?:about|on|regarding|covering|explaining|teaching)\b(.+)' captures topic after the connector but the fallback path (no connector) then relies on stripping outcome + audience + filler words. This works well for the tested corpus, but 'I want to make a workbook' returns no topic (correct — need_topic), while 'workbook on X' correctly returns topic=X. Consider adding tests for edge cases like 'video: forex for beginners' (colon connector) and 'course covering pips' (already covered by connector regex).

factory_concierge.py::_get_session — creates a new session if session_id doesn't exist in db (silent). This is intentional for a resumable UX, but consider warning the caller when the client-supplied session_id is unknown so the client can detect session drift after backend restarts.

FactoryConcierge.js — greeted useRef pattern (lines 27, 43) correctly prevents the double-greeting under React StrictMode double-mount. Verified in the UI: exactly one greeting bubble on first load and after every hard navigation.

FactoryConcierge.js::launch — passes slots.outcome_id/topic/audience/goal to POST /factory-os/projects then navigates to plan.launch.route with ?project=<id>. Correct — but note that MO-028 tests pass gold_master_candidate_ready via improvement-loop, not via the Concierge launch button (per the review request, launch is NOT clicked in tests to avoid side effects on continuity projects).

routers/factory_os.py — ConciergeInput uses Optional[bool]=False for use_ai and Optional[str]=None for session_id, correctly defaulting to the deterministic $0 path. Auth required via Depends(get_current_user). 401 verified when Authorization header is absent.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (greeting-once + full request flow → ready+launch + gap flow → begin-knowledge + reset + suggestion chip → advance — all verified; Launch button intentionally not clicked)

seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Each concierge message writes into db.concierge_sessions (expected audit trail). improvement-loop calls write into db.improvement_runs (expected).
